{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check the size of the loyal group
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
print(f'Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}')

# Check the converted column for loyal customers
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
print(f'Number of conversions among loyal customers: {converted_loyal}')

# Compute conversion fraction
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal
print(f'Fraction converted among loyal customers: {fraction_converted}')"}
